svg.title: Combat · Reactions, roll details and controller
svg.text: A Dire Wolf hits Silvain: d20 10 + 5 = 15 vs AC 11.
Shield: +5 AC until the start of Silvain's next turn (AC 16),
so this attack misses, and so do later ones that roll under 16.
Costs: Silvain's Reaction and a level 1 slot (3 of 4 left).
Auto when it turns a hit to a miss
d20: 14 (Advantage: rolled 14 and 6 · Wolf Prone within 5 ft)
